## Core Concept: isolated-platform discoverability

A typical client diagnostic profile where content is discoverable on the originating platform (e.g., Bilibili in-platform search 5/8 keywords rank 1) but NOT discoverable across search engines (Google / Bing 0/4 probes) or AI-augmented search (Perplexity / Kimi / 豆包). This pattern is far more common than "channel is dead" or "content is bad" — and it's diagnosable with a 4-probe × 3-engine × 6-AI-platform × query-trichotomy framework.

## Method

- **4 probes**: `site:URL` / pure article ID / full title exact match / author + core keywords
- **3 search engines**: Google / Bing / 百度
- **6 AI search platforms**: Perplexity / Kimi 联网 / 豆包 / 通义联网 / 秘塔 AI / 夸克 AI
- **Query trichotomy**: brand terms / question terms / long-tail exact terms
- **Hit detection**: strict page-level (non-root URL must contain domain stem + path identifier), locked by 18 pinned test cases
